issue_context.title: [Feature]: Hide response.* calls from test reports
comments: We discussed this tonight and agree that these shouldn't be shown in test reports. There's nothing action-like about `await response.text()`. We'll stop emitting steps for them, so they're hidden from both the HTML report and the trace.
Thanks! I'm really looking forward to the new version
@Skn0tt Will this also apply to `await response.json()` calls?
I can still see this steps in the report. @Skn0tt @pavelfeldman Can they also be removed somehow?
I can also see them still in report.
Please open a bug report about that so we can investigate.

review_comments: Maybe we should start annotating getters in the protocol since it also applies to e.g. innerText etc.
